trainer.dialogueBefore: Team Rocket Grunt: Team Rocket never gives up! Battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Team Rocket Grunt: We never give up... but I do.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Team Rocket Grunt: You think you can take back this building alone?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Team Rocket Grunt: Huh. Maybe you can.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Scientist Parker: I programmed every door in this building. You won't get far!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Scientist Parker: You got far enough.

worker_m.name: Worker
dialog: The doors are locked by card. The Card Key is somewhere in the building.

scientist_2.name: Scientist
dialog: I locked myself in here when Team Rocket came. Is it safe to come out?
